authority: Read-only database schema preflight before any initialization, migration, or recovery write; supported-schema migrations; SQLite integrity/recovery status; exact Owner confirmation and verified backup; all ordinary operations remain behind the recovery gate.
entry_condition: Application startup performs schema preflight before writes, or Owner requests a current Strategy workspace reset/recovery.
failure_behavior: Active work, current Champion, invalid state, stale preflight, or incorrect confirmation blocks reset before mutation.
If database backup cannot be verified, reset/recovery does not proceed.
A newer schema, missing/corrupt schema metadata, unreadable database, or pending SQLite journal/sidecar blocks startup and reset without automatic recovery, downgrade, or database mutation.
While recovery is required or status is unavailable, ordinary API/UI operations remain blocked and the UI explains why.
invariants: No Owner operational database is read or changed during source tests; tests use synthetic temporary databases.
Read the exact schema version through a read-only preflight before initialize_database, baseline registration, migrations, reconciliation, recovery status, or Strategy reset preflight/count access.

database_status, database_recovery_status, _read_counts, and _connect use the canonical schema guard before any read-write SQLite connection; application-schema compatibility and physical SQLite integrity are reported as separate facts.
A schema newer than the application is reported as INCOMPATIBLE_NEWER_SCHEMA and cannot reach automatic recovery or reset.
Unreadable or malformed schema metadata and pending journal/sidecar state fail closed with no database or evidence mutation.
Only owned Strategy-generated state is reset; EA baseline and provider settings are preserved.
The original corrupt database is retained in quarantine after a verified backup.
Recovery reports READY only after rebuilding and revalidating the current schema.
purpose: Prevent silent or unsafe loss of Strategy state and provide a fail-closed, explicit path to recover corrupt operational state.
restart_behavior: Every startup and direct migration/recovery entrypoint rechecks schema compatibility before enabling operations or writing.
Repeated blocked startup attempts leave the database and its SQLite sidecars unchanged.
rollback_behavior: A verified backup and quarantined original remain available; recovery failures do not claim reset success.
title: Owner-confirmed Strategy reset and fail-closed database recovery

transitions.action: Read schema metadata without writes before initialization, baseline registration, migration, or recovery.
Continue only for a fresh database or a schema version supported by this build.
Block startup and all normal/reset operations when the stored version is newer than the supported schema; expose a diagnostic and do not invoke recovery.
Block startup and reset when metadata is missing/malformed/unreadable or SQLite journal/sidecar state prevents a stable preflight.
Preflight exact active work, Champion authority, generated state, database integrity, and protected baseline.
Show blockers and do not mutate when any reset precondition is false.
Show deletion/preservation plan and require exact current confirmation.
Create and verify SQLite backup, revalidate inside the write transaction, clear only owned generated Strategy state, then verify result.
On corrupt/unopenable state, block ordinary routes and expose only recovery status/reset until readiness is restored.
Require exact explicit recovery confirmation; create/verify backup before quarantining the corrupt database.
Quarantine original, initialize schema and Strategy baseline, then verify state before reporting completion.
